description: This Java class defines the response to a RetrieveFeature command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates details about the retrieved feature associated with a specific Thing ID, including JSON serialization/deserialization, and provides methods for creating and handling such responses.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureResponse
classes.description: A final, immutable class representing the response to a RetrieveFeature command, including JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for the retrieved feature and associated Thing ID.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods to create a RetrieveFeatureResponse instance from ThingId, featureId, JSON objects, or JSON strings, optionally including headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrieveFeatureResponse from a JSON string or object, deserializing the JSON structure into class fields.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the retrieved feature.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns the Feature object that was retrieved.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the feature, respecting the schema version.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified entity JSON.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs the JSON pointer path to the feature resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds the response payload fields to a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicate.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of RetrieveFeatureResponse for equality purposes.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare RetrieveFeatureResponse objects.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate a hash code for RetrieveFeatureResponse objects.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the RetrieveFeatureResponse object.
